name: CONUS+
summary: CONUS+ moved the low-threshold germanium CEvNS programme from Brokdorf to Leibstadt in Switzerland with improved detectors and shielding. It reported a reactor-antineutrino recoil signal in the fully coherent regime.
detection_principle: High-purity germanium detectors measure ionization from small nuclear recoils. Heavy passive shielding, active vetoes and reactor-off data control backgrounds; signal predictions include the germanium nuclear-recoil ionization yield.

status.label: Operating / data taking
status.evidence: The cited publication documents this stage; its publication date is distinct from the data-taking period.

key_parameters.name: First signal
key_parameters.value: 395 ± 106 events from 119 reactor-on days; 3.7 sigma significance

key_parameters.name: Detector upgrade
key_parameters.value: Three new detectors with 2.4 times more mass installed in November 2024

results.summary: The measured recoil excess agreed with the Standard Model prediction within uncertainties and established a compact reactor-neutrino detection method.
